# Ekstra: Blodbad på Wall Street

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a special Danish episode of Store Penge, recorded after a historic US sell-off: Nasdaq fell 5.5%, Nvidia fell 9%, and AMD, Micron and Sandisk dropped 17-22%. Guest Mikkel Rosenvold says markets fear Democratic midterm winners will slow the data-center and AI build-out. He calls the reaction overdone and sees buying chances in beaten-down AI semiconductors, mainly memory chips (Micron) and Marvell, but expects more volatility before Christmas because of Nvidia's earnings, the Anthropic IPO and interest rates. European and Danish stocks are seen as a relative hedge against AI.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Down 17% with a low valuation. HBM memory is still in short supply whatever happens with data-center slowdowns. Guest plans to rotate back into AI names gradually.

#### Reasoning

Guest Mikkel Rosenvold thinks the AI sell-off went too far. He sees governors and Congress as unlikely to stop AI in the long run, with Trump's veto and tech lobbying as checks. He expects an AI comeback in 2027 and prefers memory chips because high-end HBM demand holds up even if data-center building slows. He advises buying in small steps because more falls could come before Christmas.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Democrats pass binding legislation that stops AI or data-center build-out
- if HBM shortage eases
- if US rates keep rising
- if a weak Nvidia report triggers a sector-wide de-rating

> *"der vil stadig være efterspørgsel på de her high-end, high-bandwidth memorychips, som bl.a. Micron laver"*

---

### 🟢 MRVL — Marvell | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down 16%. Guest is looking at Marvell as an AI infrastructure name to buy on the dip.

#### Reasoning

This is part of the guest's plan to rotate gradually from consumer staples and energy back into AI infrastructure over the next few months. He still believes in the AI build-out and calls the sell-off an overreaction. He warns it takes nerve and the market may fall further in the near term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI build-out is materially halted by regulation
- if rate fears escalate
- if sector sentiment keeps deteriorating into 2027

> *"aktier som Marvel, som vi også har talt om, er faldet 16%"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Fell 9%. The earnings report around 17 Nov is a near-term risk event, and the guest is unsure it will be very good.

#### Reasoning

The guest names the Nvidia earnings report as a source of volatility in the near term. Peers such as AMD met expectations but disappointed. He is positive on the AI sector over the longer term, but there is no explicit buy call on Nvidia, so watch it around the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nvidia earnings disappoint on guidance
- if AI capex expectations for 2027 are cut

> *"Jeg er ikke sikker på, at det Nvidia-regnskab bliver super godt."*
